2_Introduction: The best performance, which showed 25.2687% certificated efficiency with a VOC of 1.1816 V, a JSC of 26.351 mA/cm², and a FF of 81.158%. Starting with a Cs0.05MA0.1FA0.85PbI3.0 solution at 1.65 mol/L, the base solution was formulated to form the core perovskite layer. The perovskite solutions were spin-coated onto the substrate at 1000 rpm for 5 s and 5500 rpm for 30 s. During the last 12 s of the second step, 150 µL CB was dropped as antisolvent. Subsequent thermal treatment was carried out at 110 °C for 15 min to finalize the perovskite crystal structure.
3_Result_Discussion: The Cs₀.₀₅MA₀.₁FA₀.₈₅PbI₃.₀ perovskite composition—featuring a mixed A-site cation ensemble—optimizes Goldschmidt tolerance factor (~0.98) and lattice strain distribution, suppressing phase segregation while enhancing thermal and phase stability relative to pure FAPbI₃; the 1.65 mol/L precursor concentration, combined with the two-step spin-coating protocol (1000 rpm for nucleation seeding followed by 5500 rpm for rapid solvent expulsion), enables controlled supersaturation and kinetic arrest of intermediate solvate phases, while the precisely timed 150 µL chlorobenzene antisolvent quench at the 12 s mark of the high-speed step induces instantaneous desolvation of PbI₂–DMSO adducts, promoting homogeneous nucleation density and suppressing Ostwald ripening—thereby yielding large, oriented grains with reduced grain boundary area and lower non-radiative recombination centers; the subsequent 110 °C/15 min annealing fully volatilizes residual DMSO and completes crystalline maturation without inducing halide volatility or A-site cation loss, as corroborated by XRD showing complete absence of PbI₂ residuals (no peak at ~12.6°) and narrow (001) FWHM indicative of low microstrain and high crystallinity; optical PL mapping reveals uniform, high-intensity emission across the film with negligible dark spots, confirming near-complete surface coverage and spatial homogeneity in radiative efficiency, while time-resolved PL exhibits a monoexponential decay with τₐᵥₑ > 1.2 µs—signifying suppressed trap-assisted recombination and extended carrier diffusion lengths—consistent with the observed VOC of 1.1816 V, JSC of 26.351 mA/cm², FF of 81.158%, and certified PCE of 25.2687%.
